# Jianlai Tutorials: Setup, Themes, Layouts and Input Checks

> Enable the keyboard, then check input, themes, backgrounds, fonts, layouts and supported fields separately.

## App and version

- [Jianlai (键来): Custom Keyboard for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/jianlai/index.md): Explore Jianlai themes, fonts, backgrounds and space-bar customisation, Chinese, English and Japanese input, 26-key and nine-key layouts, piano sounds and haptic feedback.
Version listed: 1.0.5; checked 2026-11-20; iOS 16.0+ / iPadOS 16.0+.
This is the catalog baseline, not a promise that every release has identical UI. Individual guides specify their own version context.

## Lessons in learning order

- [1. Enable Jianlai: add the system keyboard and type in an ordinary note](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-enable-system-keyboard-first-note/index.md): Separate installing the app, adding its keyboard and actually selecting it, while retaining existing input methods. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [2. Switch Jianlai across two ordinary editors and identify the active keyboard](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-switch-keyboards-across-ordinary-editors/index.md): Compare the system keyboard and Jianlai with one short passage, distinguishing enabled from currently active. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [3. Compare Jianlai themes: preview, active keyboard and restoration](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-built-in-theme-preview-apply-return/index.md): Compare two visible themes with the same text, keeping previews separate from active-keyboard results. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [4. Set a Jianlai background while keeping keys and candidates readable](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-background-image-key-label-readability/index.md): Use an authorised simple image to check background application without mistaking decoration for functional keys. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [5. Check Jianlai fonts and sizes across key labels, candidates and document text](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-font-size-label-candidate-comparison/index.md): Hold the theme fixed and use one passage to identify where font and size changes actually apply. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [6. Style the Jianlai space bar and verify space insertion separately](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-spacebar-style-and-insertion-check/index.md): Change one visible space-bar style condition, then check its actual function in document text. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [7. Compare Jianlai’s Chinese 26-key and nine-key layouts with one passage](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-chinese-26-nine-key-layout-comparison/index.md): Keep language and theme fixed while checking layout selection, candidate confirmation and editing. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [8. Separate Jianlai’s app language from its keyboard input languages](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-interface-language-input-language-separation/index.md): Use the actual Chinese, English and Japanese entries to distinguish interface labels from document input. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [9. Check Jianlai piano sound, haptics and text insertion separately](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-piano-sound-haptic-separate-controls/index.md): Compare sound and haptics with a few nonsensitive keystrokes, changing one feedback condition per round. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [10. Diagnose Jianlai by field type: ordinary text, secure input and host restrictions](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-secure-fields-host-keyboard-boundaries/index.md): Start with a working ordinary note and identify platform boundaries without treating extra permissions as a universal repair. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [11. Proofread 会议 and 会意 in Jianlai using context and committed text](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-homophone-huiyi-context-committed-text/index.md): Use three original sentences to check candidate selection and document text instead of assuming matching input letters establish the intended word. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [12. Deliver a mixed Chinese/English version note in Jianlai](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-mixed-chinese-english-version-note/index.md): Fix an original Chinese/English version note and verify input states and final characters segment by segment. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [13. Transcribe example email and URL text in Jianlai without sending it](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-offline-email-url-ascii-copy-check/index.md): Use reserved-domain examples for an offline address card, checking ASCII delimiters, case and spaces. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [14. Enter signed decimals and units with Jianlai as an exact text card](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-signed-decimal-unit-text-card/index.md): Create three original numeric text lines, verifying signs and units without treating keyboard entry as measurement or calculation. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [15. Distinguish committed line breaks from screen wrapping in a Jianlai draft](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-three-line-draft-hard-break-soft-wrap/index.md): Enter three ordinary text items and verify their original line boundaries after display changes, without assuming a task-management feature. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [16. Revise one character with Jianlai and verify neighbouring text](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-one-character-revision-neighbour-check/index.md): Change one location in a saved original draft while retaining target, positioning and neighbouring-text evidence. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [17. Keep separate Chinese and ASCII punctuation contracts in Jianlai](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-chinese-ascii-punctuation-two-contracts/index.md): Prepare two punctuation-specified versions of the same wording and inspect quotes, colon, comma, ending and version dot separately. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [18. Name, recolour and reopen an editable Jianlai theme working draft](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-editable-theme-name-colour-save-reopen/index.md): Preserve provenance and original values in an actually editable theme, then complete one traceable appearance change. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [19. Map Jianlai’s input controls across two actual iPad space states](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-ipad-space-input-control-map/index.md): Hold a text card, theme and input scheme fixed while comparing reachable controls and retained text, without assuming split or floating keyboards. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [20. Recover changed Jianlai settings one condition at a time from a working baseline](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-baseline-one-setting-at-time-recovery/index.md): Preserve evidence of a working input state and restore language, layout or appearance separately, without assuming automatic backups or a universal reset. Originally published: 2026-11-16.
- [21. Jianlai tutorial 21: enter a date-time card with explicit padding and timezone limits](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-local-date-time-zero-padding-field-card/index.md): Use Jianlai to make a local text card with fixed year, month, day, hour, minute, hyphens and a space, then check its characters, fields and purpose separately. The deliverable is an ordinary note, not a configured calendar event, alarm or timezone-qualified network timestamp. Each step separates typing from host date recognition. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [22. Jianlai tutorial 22: type a CSV source record with commas and escaped quotes](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-csv-comma-quote-three-field-source-record/index.md): Use one original three-field CSV exercise to record Jianlai character entry, any host rewriting and external field interpretation separately. Retain the raw line and a manual field ledger. This lesson does not treat the keyboard as a CSV importer or confuse separator commas with commas inside fields. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [23. Jianlai tutorial 23: type a JSON object and check strings, numbers and paired symbols](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-json-object-string-number-source-contract/index.md): Type an original two-member JSON object with Jianlai in an ordinary draft, delivering its source, a member-type ledger and one repaired counterexample. Verify accurate entry separately from external parsing. Jianlai supplies text input; it is not presented as a JSON editor, parser or data-upload tool. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [24. Jianlai tutorial 24: enter an offline Markdown link source and check its boundaries](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-markdown-inline-link-offline-source-brackets/index.md): Type an offline Markdown link source with Jianlai and check the bracketed label, parenthesized destination and literal address separately. The sample uses a reserved invalid domain: send no request and do not click to test it. The deliverables are source text and a paper interpretation, not claimed successful rendering or an available link. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [25. Jianlai tutorial 25: type a two-state task-list source and check its spaces](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-gfm-task-list-source-two-state-card/index.md): Type an original two-line GFM task-list source with Jianlai, marking unchecked and checked character states while preserving hard line breaks, ASCII punctuation and required spaces. Deliver a copyable draft and grammar check card. A textual marker is not proof of completed work, and Jianlai is not claimed to manage reminders, lists or Markdown rendering. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [26. Jianlai tutorial 26: preserve leading zeros and distinguish identifiers from quantities](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-zero-preserving-identifier-quantity-three-line-ledger/index.md): Enter an original three-line ledger for an identifier, quantity and lot, preserving each leading zero with Jianlai and separating character contracts from external numeric conversion. Deliver copyable source, a field-role ledger and one precise repair. Numerically similar appearances do not establish identical identifiers. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [27. Jianlai tutorial 27: map keyboard-background visibility with an original nine-cell image](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-nine-region-background-visibility-map/index.md): Prepare your own nine-cell background image for Jianlai and record what remains visible in preview, actual input and another available screen state. The outcome is a nine-region table tied to source locations and observation conditions. No crop control is assumed, and obscured or absent regions are not automatically interpreted as deleted image content. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [28. Jianlai tutorial 28: compare confusable glyphs without confusing appearance with characters](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-confusable-latin-digit-three-line-glyph-card/index.md): Use three fixed lines of Latin letters and digits to record legibility separately on keycaps, any available candidate area and host body text, then change just one real font-display setting. Deliver a character-identity card and layered observation table. Similar appearance does not mean identical code points, and no font is claimed inherently more accurate or medically beneficial. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [29. Jianlai tutorial 29: hand a copy between two hosts and revise only the target](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-two-host-copy-handoff-target-only-revision/index.md): Use two original lines to copy a draft between two private ordinary editing hosts, then use Jianlai to change only the target copy’s status word. Retain the source, initial handoff and revised target for comparison. Copy and paste belong to the host or system; Jianlai supplies text input. No cloud sync, clipboard history or cross-app format fidelity is assumed. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [30. Jianlai tutorial 30: record host undo-redo states without assuming one character per action](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-host-undo-redo-observed-text-state-chain/index.md): Use Jianlai to revise the minutes in a safe practice copy, then record text states through the host’s actual Undo and Redo facilities. Deliver before, after and each observed intermediate state. Edit grouping is determined by actual host behavior, not an assumed one-character rule or invented Jianlai-specific controls. Originally published: 2026-11-17.
- [31. Jianlai one-handed width: check percentages and placement only on a nonfloating iPhone keyboard](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-iphone-one-hand-width-percent-left-right-frame/index.md): Use one fixed input card to compare a full-width baseline with left- and right-handed states, changing only one available width value. Deliver percentage, available-frame and actual-input records. The official image explicitly limits this width setting to nonfloating iPhone keyboards; seeing its setting on iPad does not establish the same effect there. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [32. Jianlai font import: trace an authorized source file through selection and restoration](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-licensed-font-file-import-identity-select-restore/index.md): Pass a font working file with a clear source and license through the installed import control, then check selection and actual keyboard display. Deliver provenance, import response and applied observations. Downloading is not application, and no universal format, variable-axis or host-document font support is promised. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [33. Jianlai missing-character fallback: separate font mappings, visible Chinese and rendering claims](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-font-cmap-coverage-system-fallback-evidence/index.md): Compare Latin text and one unmapped Chinese character using a verified font: inspect character mappings externally before observing the keyboard. Deliver coverage evidence and display records. The official image says missing characters use a system font, but visual resemblance does not establish precisely which system family rendered a glyph. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [34. Jianlai candidate-size scopes: separate labels, annotations and composition from candidate text](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-candidate-number-annotation-encoding-font-size-scopes/index.md): Test the separately listed candidate-text, candidate-number, annotation and encoding-area size controls one at a time, holding font and theme fixed. Deliver a scope ledger without requiring every scheme to display annotations or numbers or treating setting values as measured screen pixels. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [35. Jianlai key feedback: compare four states of bubbles and bottom borders](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-key-bubble-bottom-border-two-toggle-four-state/index.md): Arrange the real key-bubble and bottom-border toggles into four independent states, checking transient feedback and static edges with one fixed card. Deliver a state matrix and actual input. A bubble is not committed text, and a border change does not establish changed touch areas, sound or haptics. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [36. Jianlai Shift state: separate a single change, the lock setting and double-tap retention](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-shift-state-lock-single-double-tap-three-letter-trials/index.md): Use a short letter card in one ordinary text field to compare the original setting, a single Shift action after changing state locking, and a separate double-tap trial. Reconcile actual keycaps with committed characters instead of treating one setting, sentence capitalization and retained capitals as one rule. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [37. Jianlai inline mode: distinguish the toolbar-height recommendation of 40 from observed candidate space](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-inline-mode-toolbar-height-forty-visible-candidate-frame/index.md): In one ordinary text field, compare the original inline-mode value, the changed state and the actual toolbar height. The official image recommends a toolbar height of 40 after enabling. Keep recommendation, saved value and observed space separate rather than treat 40 as every device’s total keyboard height or a guaranteed improvement. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [38. Jianlai Japanese practice card: check two Hiragana phrases and two Japanese full stops](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-japanese-hiragana-two-phrases-nine-characters-language-evidence/index.md): Use the original あさ。あおいそら。 as a nine-character practice card. Establish an actually available Japanese input route, then check kana, Japanese full stops and committed text separately. A public language switch does not promise a particular Japanese layout, romaji conversion or candidate feature; follow the actual available path. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [39. Jianlai letter coverage: check all twenty-six letters with an original twelve-word sentence](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-english-pangram-letter-coverage-set-frequency-original-sentence/index.md): Enter an original English practice sentence and check words, spaces, the period and case-insensitive letter coverage separately. Seeing all twenty-six letters does not pass every key position, candidate or accuracy claim. Keep the occurrence set and exact source comparison as separate results. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [40. Jianlai diagnostic record: separate the local diagnostic entry from an external reproduction card](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-local-diagnostics-external-reproduction-card-observation-boundaries/index.md): Start with a three-character card in an ordinary note, retain confirmable information from the actual local diagnostic entry and write a separate manual reproduction card. Distinguish user observations, diagnostic-page text and proposed causes, without promising repair, automatic export, exhaustive host checks or report sending. Originally published: 2026-11-18.
- [41. Jianlai polyphonic-character card: enter six words containing 行, 重 and 乐](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-polyphonic-character-six-word-context-card/index.md): Type an original three-line, six-word card, choosing the intended complete words before checking committed text. 行, 重 and 乐 have different Mandarin readings in these contexts. Correct glyphs do not prove semantic understanding; follow the actual Chinese scheme without prescribing pinyin, Zhuyin or candidate order for every scheme. Originally published: 2026-11-19.
- [42. Jianlai seven-character palindrome: symmetry is not exact source equality](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-original-seven-character-palindrome-symmetry-versus-equality/index.md): Enter the original card 江边灯照灯边江, check seven positions and use two controls to distinguish symmetry, length and exact equality. Analyze the property externally without claiming automatic Jianlai poetry recognition or substituting mirrored glyphs/right-to-left layout. Originally published: 2026-11-19.
- [43. Jianlai four-line acrostic: check 雨岸星灯 initials separately from the complete text](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-original-four-line-acrostic-initials-versus-complete-text/index.md): Type four original five-character lines beginning 雨, 岸, 星 and 灯. Preserve logical newlines, then check initial order and complete lines separately. Follow this declared form without treating soft wrapping as new poetic lines or claiming automatic Jianlai generation/scoring. Originally published: 2026-11-19.
- [44. Jianlai thirteen-digit practice: calculate an ISBN-style check digit externally](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-isbn13-training-digits-alternating-checksum-not-registration/index.md): Type the mathematical practice string 9781234567897 as thirteen ASCII digits, then check its final digit externally using ISBN-13 alternating weights. This checks entry/arithmetic, neither queries nor claims allocation, identifies no real publication and promises no Jianlai ISBN recognition/scanning. Originally published: 2026-11-19.
- [45. Jianlai dot-and-dash card: transcribe HI ALL groups without treating spaces as transmission timing](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-morse-hi-all-ascii-text-groups-not-timed-transmission/index.md): Transcribe HI ALL into this explicitly defined offline dot-and-dash notation using periods, ASCII hyphens, spaces and a word-separator slash. Check letter mappings externally against the ITU International Morse table. Display separators are this card’s convention, not Jianlai encoding, decoding, sound generation or radio transmission. Originally published: 2026-11-19.
- [46. Jianlai TSV handoff: real tabs between three fields, not four spaces](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-tsv-real-tabs-three-column-handoff/index.md): A visually aligned three-column note is not necessarily TSV. Enter field text with Jianlai in a normal editor, then insert or transfer actual tabs through the host’s available controls. Deliver the literal text, per-line field checks and target-import observations. The keyboard does not parse tables, and alignment in a note does not prove that columns were imported. Originally published: 2026-11-19.
- [47. Jianlai YAML source: preserve nesting with two spaces and a literal hash with quotes](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-yaml-two-space-nested-mapping-quoted-hash/index.md): Type a four-line YAML card in an ordinary text field, checking nesting, ASCII colons and quoted text. Deliver the source, a dedented control and external parsing evidence. Jianlai enters text, the host edits it and a separate tool interprets YAML; visual alignment does not activate a configuration. Originally published: 2026-11-19.
- [48. Jianlai regex source: escape a literal dot and check two ASCII digits with full matching](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-regex-literal-dot-ascii-two-digits-fullmatch/index.md): Type a pattern explicitly intended for Python re and four test strings, then check complete-string matching externally. Backslash, dot and braces have separate roles. Jianlai is not a code runner, and other regex engines do not automatically inherit these results. Originally published: 2026-11-19.
- [49. Jianlai formula text: distinguish Co from CO and apply the trailing two to the whole group](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/jianlai-chemical-symbol-case-parentheses-co-calcium-hydroxide/index.md): Enter two case-sensitive symbols and a parenthesized formula in an ordinary draft, then check symbol boundaries and atom counts externally. This is text checking, without preparing, handling or identifying chemicals. Jianlai is not an element recognizer, and visual subscripts do not establish identical source text. Originally published: 2026-11-19.

Separate keyboard entry, host formatting and mathematical interpretation. Here e is neither a unit nor Euler’s constant, and normalized display does not establish exact source text.
